translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Bzkq Mrbrtr Mz Drtwrm Nigr Kxnzakxpu Nemqng

content.text: ?Gct, memule tqrtctx-alope-ngrn nigr,
Mz nzngyatikr drtwrm nigr sip nemqng?
Nadcpx mz drtwrm nigr kcng tqmcpxqng mzli kc bqnc, mz nzarlapx-krbzm nigr mz mq kxnzakxputilr nigr,
X mz nzmnc-krme bagr mz Newz Saeon.
Vztr ena mrlcde mz Mangr-nzangiongr nim Jerusalem,
Murde namcq nzodati-atwrnrkr enqmi rgrng da amrlx mrka.
Enqmi lcng nzmalqlvzlr Mangr-nzangiongr nim,
Nzpetr-krdr nc nqngq ngr nibr kxrmailz ngrdr mz nounc kx nzatulr mrlcde mz nzaelwapx-krdr nzaovxio-krdr nigr.
Nztaglctilr mz xks x hama scdrng da kcng tzlzting amrlx mrlcde,
Mz nzapu-krdr ncblo kx narlaking nounc.
Nzkatrpzlr nyr ngr Mangr-nzangiongr nim,
Mz nzmatinetrkr drtwrdr nztr-esz'ngr-krm.
X nzangctitxdr mrkcng amrlx tqangio-ngrgr nim mz drtc' nyzm,
Murde narnzlvzo-atwrnr-ngrdr nigr.
Dalr nzangio-krgr nim lcng amrlx nzmrbrtipeng,
X trpengr profet kx narpim bagr mzli kx naesakingr nzkxpungr lc.
?Gct, myx mzli kx nakrlzbz enqmi rgrng nzxtrnga-krdr nim?
?Myx kxmule, narlrtx-alope-ngrbzme nzycmne-atrkati-krdr drtqm?
Bzkq mnc-lrpitxn,
A' odati nidr mz nzokatr-krm nigr.
Gct, kxmule-esz' nzmusrnepegr lc, a' nim King rgr yzutr pnz mzli kc bqnc.
X nzwrde kqlu kx arlapx-ngrn nigr.
Sc tqakipxq Prla Bla mz zmatq ngrm.
X tqtamyrnr-ngrn nardr mepwz kc tqngi Ijipt.
Murde aovxioq kxnzetu rdrng,
X kabzme nrkrdrtqdr nangq animol ngr lzke.
Sc tqaglqwiq mrkc tqrpnakilzm aulz x narlue.
X apz-kzq me nakawicngr LueJodzn.
Nim kxrpalz kc tqwz-ngrde ngrlx x nrlckxbq,
X nim kc tqryrlq nepi x temz mrnyzdr.
X nim kc tqryrlqbz me nangi bz ngr prla x drtc',
X yrlq-kzpzme mzli r zbao x zpq.
A' Yawe, nadcpx mz drtwrm kx enqmi rgrng nzxtrnga-ngrdr nim,
X nzatrkatilr drtqm mz nzycmne-krdr mz nzobqszo-krdr nim.
Bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrm kxnzakxpu nemqng,
Mz nzapusr-krm nigr bona kx nalolvzti kuli kzpeto.
Nadcpx mz drtwrm Nzesz'tikr Drtwrgu mz nzarlapx-krm nigr,
Murde mzli ka ncblo kxayo nzkqlupeng kxnzmnc-kapqneng mz nzlo.
Bzkq rlr-ngrbzme badr nzaovxio-krdr nigr kxnzakxpung,
Murde nigr leplz txneng kx trpnzngr scdr zmatq naglqlzkr nim.
Gct, vzm mz nzatubqti-krm drtwr kxnzobqszolr nim,
Mz nzdcpxkr mz drtwrm kx nzxtrnga-zvz-ngrdr nim.
Bzkq mrbrtr mz drtwrm enqmi rmqng kx nznemi-zvzlr zngya mz nzatrkati-krdr nim.
A' vzm mz nzawx-nabu-krm nidr mz natqdr.
